content:
**Insurrection** is a quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

Eugene has a plan to take down The Rust King and needs the help of the Vault Dweller. He asks them to help recruit three individuals as part of his plan.

The first person the Vault Dweller is tasked with recruiting is Moose, a former colonel for the United States military. He asks the Vault Dweller to take down a patrol of Rust Raiders that have been attacking his team near Athens. After taking out the enemies and collecting the supplies, the Vault Dweller can return to Eugene for the next two people.

He will ask the Vault Dweller to track down Leonard, who is camped out in the Railroad Service Yard, and Magpie who can be found at an old diner. He asks the Vault Dweller to get to Leonard first, as he is always on the move. Meeting Leonard inside of his hideout, he tells the Vault Dweller he cannot leave the Railroad Service Yard until his son Owen returns. The Vault Dweller can offer to help find Owen to get Leonard to agree to come along. Arriving at the scene, the Vault Dweller will find Owen deceased, skewered on a wooden pike with a note, To Madman. Returning Owen's Ring to Leonard, he bursts out in rage and agrees to seek revenge on The Rust King and his raiders.

After Leonard agrees, the Vault Dweller must travel to The Chop Shop in order to recruit Magpie. She is hiding from a loan shark, who is waiting to kill her. She gives the Vault Dweller the Crazy Guy's Note which gives them instructions as to where a cap stash can be located. To get her to leave the basement of The Chop Shop, the Vault Dweller must retrieve the cap stash and bring them to the loan shark, Gregory Dixon, who is located in Highway Town. After paying off the loan shark, the Vault Dweller can return to Magpie.

Arriving back at The Chop Shop, Eugene is there with Magpie waiting. Magpie reveals that Eugene was once a raider known as Spike, and she is hesitant to work with him. However, she agrees to help and Eugene explains his plan to the Vault Dweller.
